page.overview:
Who is Father Marius?

Father Marius was the Imperium's Chief Missionary on Aurum, having been present during the murder of Sister Rachayel of the Orders Hospitaller.

A gaunt, balding man, by the time of the early 9th century of the 41st Millennium, Marius had been in Haistand -- the planetary capital of Aurum -- for many solar years. He was able to offer offworlders a great deal of insight into the city of Haistand, the people of Aurum, and their leader -- Rylus Darkscourge.

To the Deathwatch, Marius related the details of Sister Rachayel's death. He was the one who found the sister's body in the Word of Faith mission, located adjacent to an altar dedicated to Saint Alicia Dominica. The body was later returned to her order for final rites.

According to Marius, Rachayel had been deeply suspicious towards the faithless present on Aurum. Towards the end of her life, she had begun to suspect that they were hiding a dark secret.
